title: Painting a Pronghorn in Gouache
content: Yesterday I painted a pronghorn in gouache for the one-hour Quick Draw event at theSKB Workshop.If you receive my blog as an email, you may need to follow thislink to watch  the video on YouTubebecause the email version doesn't support embedded videos.More info about what I mention in the video:Other artists shown:Guy Combes,John Seerey-Lester,Jeanne Mackenzie,Mort Solberg,John Phelps,Greg Beecham,Heiner Hertling, andTom Lucas.Pronghorn expert:DeVere Burt, CincinnatiAncestral cheetah-like predators:"Did False Cheetahs Give Pronghorns a Need for Speed?"Taxidermy by:Lynn StewartEvent:SKB Workshopin Dubois, Wyoming / 5 days, 15 instructors, 150 students.Music by:Kevin MacLeod, Incompetech.comGouache:MostlyHolbein,M. Graham, andWinsor & NewtonSurface:Arches Watercolor Pad.
